name: Dreamwoven Cloud Bridge
description: A bridge of woven silver clouds spanning a valley, its fibers glowing with soft starlight and shifting colors.
prompt: Hanging bridge made of interwoven luminous cloud fibers suspended between misty mountain peaks, its strands aglow with gentle starlight, ethereal twilight sky, painterly fantasy.
caption: Walk among the clouds on a bridge that dreams of stars. ☁️✨
